key.name: enabled
key.description: Use the selected work wallpaper and Windows-inspired dock while active.

key.name: scheduled
key.description: Switch the work wallpaper and dock automatically during configured work hours.

key.name: weekdays-only
key.description: Apply the work wallpaper Monday through Friday.

key.name: start-time
key.description: Local time at which the work wallpaper becomes active.

key.name: end-time
key.description: Local time at which the normal wallpaper is restored.

key.name: network-trigger
key.description: Apply Windows Work Mode only while this computer's public IP address matches one of the work public IP addresses.

key.name: work-public-ips
key.description: Public IPv4/IPv6 addresses or CIDR ranges that identify a work network.

key.name: public-ip-service
key.description: HTTPS endpoint that returns the caller's public IP address as plain text. Contacted only while the work-network rule is on.

key.name: work-wallpaper
key.description: Image file used while Windows Work Mode is active. Starts with the supplied Azure Bloom wallpaper.

key.name: icon-theme
key.description: Icon theme used while Windows Work Mode is active, such as 'Win11-dark' from mseries/install-work-mode-icons.sh. Empty keeps the current icon theme. Ignored when the theme is not installed.

key.name: window-buttons
key.description: 'unchanged' (the default) keeps your own layout, so the Mac-style buttons stay on the left. 'windows' puts minimize, maximize and close on the right of every window title bar while Windows Work Mode is active and restores your layout when it ends.
